clue.text: Give voice about the French pages striking

indicators.note: about means one thing goes around another, here the singing word wraps the rest

parts.note: to give voice is to sing
la is the French feminine form of 'the'

explanation.surface: Someone yelling at the French while striking the pages of a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal; 'the French' is the feminine French article, not anything about France.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapping is hitting with an open hand, a form of striking.

clue.text: Had to get in pig and dog

indicators.note: to get in means to be placed inside something else

parts.note: a sow is a female pig

explanation.surface: A pig and a dog both had to get inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get in' is the container signal; 'dog' is a verb here, meaning follow, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to follow them closely, to tail them.

clue.text: Matters concerning an aged fiddle

indicators.note: to fiddle with something is to tamper with it and rearrange it

explanation.surface: Business about an old violin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' rearranges AN AGED; it looks like a violin but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the list of items, or matters, to be dealt with.

clue.text: Spend a long time finding ways to get through

parts.note: to pass time is to spend it
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: Taking ages to find routes through somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Passages are corridors or routes allowing movement through.

clue.text: No very satisfactory comer

parts.note: taken as written
OK means acceptable or satisfactory

explanation.surface: A small corner that is not very satisfactory.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'corner', misread as 'comer' in the print scan.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook is a small recess or sheltered corner.

clue.text: Greek island doctor's creation

parts.note: Cos (or Kos) is an island in the Greek Dodecanese
MO, medical officer, is a doctor; with the possessive it gives MO'S

explanation.surface: A medic on a Greek island has made something of his own.
explanation.walkthrough: MO (medical officer) is a crossword staple for a doctor; the apostrophe-S comes along as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The cosmos is the whole created universe, all of creation.

clue.text: Not allowed to put down the sum paid

parts.note: out means not allowed, as in a ruling
to lay is to put down

explanation.surface: Forbidden to record the amount spent.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay is an expenditure, money laid out.

clue.text: There's many a tin in a damaged state

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

indicators.note: damaged signals that the following words are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: Plenty of tins sit in a battered condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges A TIN IN A; 'state' is a verb meaning assert.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain is to assert or declare something firmly.

clue.text: Guiding line about a point repeated

indicators.note: about means the line is wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: a string is a line or cord

indicators.note: repeated asks for the point to be given twice

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A guideline around a point made twice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repeated' doubles the compass point and 'about' wraps the line around the pair; 'Guiding' is the definition, an adjective-like participle.
explanation.definitionFit: Steering is directing the course of something, guiding it.

clue.text: A form occasioning much disgust

parts.note: a version is a particular form or variant of something

explanation.surface: Some document or style that makes people deeply disgusted.
explanation.definitionFit: An aversion is a strong dislike, a feeling of marked distaste.

clue.text: Good man prevailing in some controversy

parts.note: ST, saint, is the usual crossword good man
rife means widespread or prevailing

explanation.surface: A virtuous man winning the day in an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Strife is bitter conflict or dispute, a heated disagreement.

clue.text: One in support is to lay the groundwork

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a pier is a supporting pillar

explanation.surface: One who supports an idea lays the foundation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; 'support' looks abstract but is a physical pillar.
explanation.definitionFit: To pioneer is to open up new ground first, preparing the way for others.

clue.text: The place of the long-time radio enthusiast

parts.note: long-time means of long standing, old
a ham is an amateur radio operator

explanation.surface: Where a veteran amateur radio buff lives.
explanation.walkthrough: OLDHAM is a town in Greater Manchester, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Oldham is a town, a place in north-west England.

clue.text: Calamity silly ass tried to bring about

indicators.note: silly signals that the following letters are made to behave foolishly, i.e. rearranged

explanation.surface: A foolish donkey's attempt brings about a calamity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'silly' rearranges ASS and TRIED; 'silly ass' reads as a single insult.
explanation.definitionFit: A disaster is a sudden great misfortune, synonymous with calamity.

clue.text: Presents to send — a problem

indicators.note: problem signals that the words before are in a muddle and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Sending gifts turns out to be troublesome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'problem' rearranges TO SEND A; 'Presents' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To donate is to give, to make a gift.

clue.text: Serving men sure to make a comeback

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers serving in the army
bound, as in 'bound to happen', means sure or certain

explanation.surface: Soldiers who are certain to return to form.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebound is to bounce back or recover, staging a return.

clue.text: Pen name

definitions.meaning: to pen is to write, as when putting your signature on a document
to name is to identify; a mark or token naming something

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to pen your signature is to sign, and to put your name to something is to sign it.

clue.text: Look, then look again. That makes sense

parts.note: to eye is to look at
a sight is a look or glimpse

explanation.surface: Looking twice seems the sensible thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is the faculty of vision, one of the five senses.

clue.text: Back-number held by a beast to be far from fair

indicators.note: held by means the piece is enclosed by another

parts.note: a brute is a savage beast

indicators.note: Back means the number is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: A creature clutching an old issue, hardly a fair-minded one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' reverses the number and 'held by' places it in the beast; 'fair' means light-haired, not just.
explanation.definitionFit: A brunette has dark hair, the opposite of a blonde, or fair-haired person.

clue.text: An old creature lumbering around is confused

indicators.note: confused tells us the words before are mixed up

explanation.surface: An elderly beast trudges about in bewilderment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' is the anagram signal; 'lumbering' belongs to the definition, describing the creature's gait.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinosaur is a huge prehistoric reptile, a slow, ancient beast.

clue.text: The thread of the tale

definitions.meaning: a strand of spun fibre for knitting

explanation.definitionFit: Yarn is spun fibre for knitting and also a long-winded story.

clue.text: Savoury food — undercooked and little of it

parts.note: rare meat is lightly cooked, underdone
a bit is a small amount

explanation.surface: A dish that is underdone and served in a tiny portion.
explanation.walkthrough: Welsh rarebit is a British dish of cheese sauce on toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Rarebit is melted cheese on toast, a savoury snack.

clue.text: A perfume can give such a lift!

parts.note: a scent is a perfume

explanation.surface: A whiff of perfume can really cheer you up.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascent is a climb or rise, a lift upwards.

clue.text: Comment about a target

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a mark is a target

explanation.surface: A remark aimed at someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A remark is a spoken observation or comment.

clue.text: Soften over strong material

parts.note: to melt is to soften
on means over, upon

explanation.surface: Warming up some tough cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Melton is a heavy, durable woollen cloth used for overcoats.

clue.text: Left at home for interrupting nurse

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into the middle of something else

parts.note: in Britain a sister is a senior nurse
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone left at home to stand in for a nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interrupting' is the container signal; in Britain a sister is a senior nurse, and sinister is Latin for left.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinister originally meant on the left-hand side, as in heraldry.

clue.text: Present company made to stick together

parts.note: present means here, in attendance

explanation.surface: Those attending are told to remain united.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to hold firmly together, to bond.

clue.text: Some borrow a very great deal, but flourish

indicators.note: Some means only part of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Some people borrow huge sums yet still thrive.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across BORROW A VERY.
explanation.definitionFit: To wave is to brandish or flourish something in the air.

clue.text: Gain the impression a woman is after a gun

indicators.note: is after means the woman's piece is placed following the gun's

parts.note: gat is slang for a gun
her stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A woman chasing a gun gets the idea of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather is to infer or understand from what one has heard.

clue.text: Drop what may have a bad effect on the viewer

definitions.meaning: a steep fall of water, a large waterfall

definitions.text: what may have a bad effect on the viewer
definitions.meaning: a clouding of the eye's lens, impairing sight

explanation.definitionFit: A cataract is both a great waterfall and an eye condition that blurs vision.

clue.text: Two-nil score

parts.note: a 2 followed by a 0 written out reads as a number, and a score is that many

explanation.definitionFit: A score is twenty, and 2 then 0 written down is the number twenty.

clue.text: Bakers in specially-designed headgear

indicators.note: specially-designed says the letters have been redesigned into a new shape

explanation.surface: Bakers wearing hats made specially for them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'specially-designed' rearranges BAKERS IN; a bearskin is the tall fur cap of British guardsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: A bearskin is a tall fur cap worn by guards regiments.
